bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first Windows study tracker for CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, TIFR and JEST Physics.
bundle.longDescription: A complete offline-first Windows study tracker for CSIR-UGC NET, GATE Physics, TIFR GS and JEST Physics: official-source syllabus progress, focus timer and sessions, checklist and calendar planning, PYQ and mock-test analytics, spaced-repetition revision scheduling, study insights, verified backup and restore, and CSV/JSON portability. All personal study data stays in a local SQLite database.
